name: inspect_class

class_name.description: Short name (Character, PlayerController), full path (/Script/Engine.Actor), or Blueprint path (/Game/BP_Enemy)

include_inherited.description: Include members from parent classes (can be verbose)

limit.description: Maximum members to return per section (1-100)

name: search_nodes

query.description: Keyword search (matched against name, keywords, tooltip)

category.description: Filter by node category (e.g. Math, Physics, AI, Flow Control)

class.description: Filter to functions on a specific class (e.g. KismetMathLibrary, Character)

include_pins.description: Include full pin signatures (name, direction, type, default). More verbose but gives exact T3D info.

blueprint.description: Optional Blueprint asset path. With 'graph', scopes results to that graph (enables anim node listing when it is an animation graph).

graph.description: Optional graph name/path within 'blueprint'. An animation graph here surfaces anim node spawners.
